class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data  # 初始化数据字段

class LinkedList:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = None  # 初始化头节点字段

    # 创建链表的方法
    def create_linked_list(self):

        # 输入节点数据
        data1 = int(input())
        data2 = int(input())

class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.next = None

class LinkedList:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = None

    def create_linked_list(self):
        data1 = int(input())
        data2 = int(input())
        data3 = int(input())

        node1 = Node(data1)
        node2 = Node(data2)
        node3 = Node(data3)

        self.head = node1
        node1.next = node2
        node2.next = node3

    # 计算节点和的方法
    def calculate_sum(self):

        # 初始化总和为0
        total = 0

        current = self.head

        while current is not None:
            total += current.data
            current = current.next
        
        return total

# 创建一个链表
linked_list = LinkedList()
linked_list.create_linked_list()

# 计算链表中元素的和
